description: This file generates a student and guardian contact details report for an educational system, retrieving student info, guardian info, and roll numbers, and formatting the data into report columns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the report data based on filters, retrieving student and guardian info, and assembling report rows.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the report columns with labels and formatting.

methods.name: get_student_details
methods.description: Fetches detailed student information from the database and maps it by student ID.

methods.name: get_guardian_map
methods.description: Retrieves guardian details for students and maps guardians to their respective students.

methods.name: get_student_roll_no
methods.description: Retrieves roll numbers for students within a specific academic year, program, and batch.
